usage.xl: Floating tab bar, search field (pill), add button (circle)
usage.lg: Settings groups, timer bar, metric surface, WeChat row, finished-book row
usage.md: Primary/secondary buttons, tab selected pill, status chips, small pills
usage.sm: Trend bars (capped at half height), tiny cover thumbs

radiusDp.nestedRule: innerRadius = max(8, outerRadius - padding). Example: tab bar 24dp with 8dp inset yields a 12–16dp selected pill. Device frame 36dp with 8dp bezel yields a 28dp screen corner.

icon.selected: Keep the same 2dp outline icon. Color shifts to primary and sits on a 12dp-radius primaryContainer pill. Do not swap to a heavier filled glyph.
icon.unselected: Same glyph and stroke in the secondary color.
icon.exceptions: Android system status icons may use 16–18dp and ~1.6dp stroke; they are system chrome, not app icons.

typography.ui: Noto Sans CJK SC (or the platform CJK UI font such as Source Han Sans SC / the OEM UI font). Prefer the system font at runtime.
typography.display: Noto Serif CJK SC for the statistics duration hero only.
typography.tracking: Tighten large display type about -0.03em. Body and labels stay near 0. Do not apply a single letter-spacing to every size.
typography.leading: Tighter on the hero, comfortable on body. Scale vertical spacing with fontScale; use sp for type and dp for fixed chrome.
typography.weight: Regular for body, Bold for titles and the selected tab/filter. Do not fake a medium weight with a stroke.

press.commitOn: pointer up inside the target / ACTION_UP
press.visual: Immediate ripple plus scale ~0.97. Do not wait for click.
press.android: Compose: Indication ripple + collectIsPressedAsState scale. Views: Material ripple and a down-triggered animator. minimumInteractiveComponentSize / 48dp min touch.

androidComposeStiffness.formula: stiffness = (2π / response)^2 with mass 1, then spring(dampingRatio=1f, stiffness=...)

springDefault.androidViews: SpringAnimation with SpringForce.DAMPING_RATIO_NO_BOUNCE and a matching stiffness. Do not build a custom physics engine for the first version.

springMomentum.when: Only after a flick or throw that already carries velocity. Never add bounce to a menu or fade that just appeared.
springMomentum.velocityHandoff: Pass VelocityTracker / Compose velocity to the spring so there is no seam between drag and settle.
springMomentum.projection: Project the resting point from release velocity, then snap to the nearest legal target. Android fling/decay may be used for scrolling; if implementing a custom sheet, prefer exponential decay (decelerationRate ≈ 0.998) over v²/(2a).

motion.interruptible: Never lock input during a transition. Start the new animation from the live presentation value (Compose Animatable does this). A closing sheet the user grabs again should follow the finger.

reducedMotion.detect: Settings.Global.ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE, TRANSITION_ANIMATION_SCALE, and WINDOW_ANIMATION_SCALE. If any is 0, or the user asked for reduced motion, replace springs and slides with a 200ms opacity fade.
reducedMotion.keep: Color and opacity changes that explain a state change. Drop overshoot and parallax.

reducedTransparency.detect: No single iOS-style system flag is guaranteed on Android. If blur is expensive, contrast fails, or the user enables a high-contrast / reduce-transparency style setting, fall the tab bar back to solid surfaceRaised.
reducedTransparency.rule: Never stack a translucent layer on another translucent layer. The timer bar stays solid even when the tab bar is frosted.

touchAndAccessibility.fontScale: Type in sp. Retest layouts at fontScale 1.0, 1.3, 1.5, and 2.0. Do not clip Chinese glyphs. Expand vertical rhythm with the text; keep chrome tappable.
touchAndAccessibility.permissions: Request the camera only when the user chooses Scan ISBN from the add-book action, not at first launch.
touchAndAccessibility.contrastPolicy: Body and labels ≥ 4.5:1. Icons and graphical objects ≥ 3:1. Values in this file were computed, not estimated.

productRules.completion: 读完 is an explicit user action. A physical book at 475/500 pages may be marked finished without rewriting progress to 500/500. Do not auto-complete when current page equals total pages.
productRules.statsPages: The global statistics screen does not total pages. Physical page ranges stay on the book and its session history. WeChat Reading does not provide pages.
productRules.wechat: Until the WeChat Reading skill is actually connected, show 待接入. Do not invent daily minutes or new-note counts.
productRules.isbn: 万维易源 AppKey is entered by the user in 我的 > 图书查询配置. Scan or typed ISBN uses that API; if the lookup fails, allow manual entry.
productRules.ai: Keep a DeepSeek configuration (including 深度思考 and temperature 0–2, default 0.7; temperature disabled while 深度思考 is on) and an AI entry marked 用途待定. Do not invent AI features in the UI.
